svg.text: Plan, north up, 1 px = 0.83 m (scale bar). World frame of the estate: x east, y north, z = lawn (0). Contours on the gorge walls at z 0 / -50 / -100 / -150. Sections below are true scale (vertical = horizontal).
irrigation line: green ends, gold oat grass begins
invader convoy; new waves arrive by this road
deck z 0, 137 m; arch springs z -45;
train every 4 min; horn 60 s ahead
z -152; throw it to red, board the stopped freight
swinging bridge, 8 m over the water
25 m wide at the rim, 190 m deep;
river leaves the map; the low sun sits in it
SOUTH EDGE: head-high chaparral (manzanita, chamise), impassable; invaders' road
south wall: shaded, wet, fern, moss
THE CUT starts as a crack in the grass
Grimble (easter egg): over the dam, wades west
playable ≈ 1.1 km x 0.35 km x 190 m deep
Section A-A: north-south through the bridge (x = 20), true scale
river z -170 · Grimble 7.3 m to scale
Gunner on the south rim: solid green = sees the sunlit north wall at 130 m (the stage);
red x = the lip: he can't see the wall below his own feet (the old road);
dashed = the bottom, seen only through the mist (notice x exp(-L/35 m)).
Section B: the Cut, unrolled along its floor (360 m), true scale
rock: only seen from inside the slot;
the rims see you at the Cathedral
A. Under the bridge: catwalk, ladder, old road; ~1.3 km, 3-4 min
B. Penstock: rim path, 850 steps, powerhouse, track; ~1.25 km, 5-6 min
C. The Cut: slot canyon to the lever; ~0.5 km, 4-5 min, one-way
railway (dashed = in tunnel); freight every 4 min
gunner perch (filled: south rim; open: north rim, followers)
goal: signal lever at the West Tunnel portal
Heights (z, metres; lawn = 0): rims 0; bridge deck 0, arch springs -45;
Cut mouth -122; track / powerhouse -150; trestle deck -152;
Gate to goal: ~320 m in plan, 152 m down.
Sight rules: the lip hides the wall below a rim; mist below z -110;
shaded wall halves notice; the trestle is exposed to everything.
